note: Every fixture is honestly what its name says: official CPSC images (public domain), openly licensed test photos from Wikimedia Commons, and copies of those made with sharp (rotated, cropped, blurred), each listed with its source. Three show a product made safe, and all three were published by the U.S. CPSC with their recalls as the example of the photo the remedy asks for (26125, and 25007 images 4 and 5). None is an owner's own claim photo, and nothing here was drawn on or edited to look made safe. See user/README.md for the full set.
